newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour's Brown denies any deal with Murdoch.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour's Brown denies any deal with Murdoch.

text.p: Gordon Brown, finance spokesman for Britain's opposition Labour party, denied that any deal had been done with News Corp Ltd chairman Rupert Murdoch in return for the political support of The Sun newspaper.

The Sun, Britain's best-selling newspaper, threw its weight behind Labour leader Tony Blair on Tuesday, saying people needed "a leader with vision, purpose and courage who can fire their imaginations."
Asked in a BBC radio interview if Labour had offered Murdoch anything in return for his newspaper's support, such as a lighter regulatory regime for his broadcasting activities, Brown replied:
"There is no question of any deals or anything like that, no question at all."
